component.name: Aura
component.summary: Animated live wallpaper manager for COSMIC Desktop

description.p: Aura is an elegant, high-performance animated live wallpaper manager built natively with Rust for the System76 COSMIC Desktop environment.
Designed to deliver immersive desktop aesthetics without compromising system efficiency, Aura integrates seamlessly into modern Wayland workflows.

ul.li: 60fps Native Performance: Built from the ground up using libcosmic and wgpu for silky-smooth rendering.
Hardware-Accelerated GPU Decoding: High-efficiency video playback keeping CPU overhead and battery drain near zero.
COSMIC Auto-Theming: Dynamically adapts UI elements and accent harmonies to system themes and wallpaper palettes.
Wayland Layer-Shell Protocol: Stutter-free wallpaper rendering docked precisely below windows across multi-monitor setups.
Intelligent Resource Throttling: Automatically pauses or throttles playback when fullscreen windows or games are active.

description.p: Initial release of Aura live wallpaper manager for COSMIC Desktop.
